claim: Spine flag $0512 (Spin Dash, abilityBitmask bit 2): in scene $85 (wall_rampway) gw85_spin_dash_gate does nothing unless the player stands at exactly pixel (X $0458, Y $00D0); there a Will without the bit has his X set to $03C0, while Will with the bit, Freedan and Shadow are left alone. It does not react to an attack and opens nothing (the shipped block note says otherwise).

start.state: scene $85 reachable on foot; abilityBitmask ($0AA2) bit 2 clear, then set by memory write

trial.control: bit 2 clear: walk Will to pixel (X $0458, Y $00D0) and read player X ($0014 of the player actor at $09AA) on the next frames
trial.forced: set $0AA2 bit 2 and repeat; then repeat as Freedan with the bit clear
observe: player X after reaching the spot (expect $03C0 only for Will without the bit)

confirms: player X becomes $03C0 only for Will with bit 2 clear
refutes: Freedan or Will with the bit is moved, or the spot is never reachable by walking (the actor then has no visible effect)
